title: Chapter 6: Major Battles, Italian Occupation & Resistance (1837-1941)
content:
ሰላም የEthioFresh ጀግኖች! 👋
የFreshman ህይወት እንዴት ይዟችኋል? አሳይመንት እና ኪውዝ አላስነፍስ እያላችሁ ነው አይደል? አይዞን፣ እኛም ያለፍንበት ነው! ዛሬ ደግሞ የHistory of Ethiopia and the Horn Chapter 6 የመጨረሻውን ክፍል (ከ 6.5.2 እስከ መጨረሻው) ይዤላችሁ መጥቻለሁ። ይህ ክፍል ጦርነት፣ ጀግንነት፣ እና የጣልያን ወረራን የሚያወራ ስለሆነ እንደ ፊልም ነው የሚታየው! ፋንዲሻችሁን ይዛችሁ ተከታተሉኝ👇👇👇 🍿😎


6.5.2. Major Battles Fought Against Foreign Aggressors and Patriotism

Wad Kaltabu (1837) & Dabarki (1848)
• In 1837 at Wad Kaltabu, Kasa and Kinfu Hailu defeated the Egyptians in eastern Sudan.
• The Battle of Dabarki (1848) was fought between Kasa Hailu and Egyptian forces.
• Although Kasa showed extraordinary courage, his forces lost the battle owing to the Egyptians' superior military organization, better training, and arms.
• The deadly effect of Egyptian artillery gave Kasa a lesson to modernize his military force.

👉
በዚህ ጊዜ ካሳ (በኋላ አፄ ቴዎድሮስ) ከግብፆች ጋር ያደረጉትን ጦርነት ነው የምናየው። ዋድ ካልታቡ ላይ ካሳ አሸንፈው ነበር። ነገር ግን በ1848 በዳባርኪ ጦርነት ላይ ግብፆች ዘመናዊ መሳሪያ (Artillery) ስለነበራቸው ካሳን አሸነፏቸው። ይሄ ሽንፈት ለካሳ ትልቅ ትምህርት ሰጣቸው፤ "እኔም ጦሬን ማዘመን አለብኝ!" ብለው እንዲያስቡ አደረጋቸው። (💡 Exam Hint: የትኛው ጦርነት ነው ለቴዎድሮስ ጦራቸውን እንዲያዘምኑ ትምህርት የሰጣቸው ከተባላችሁ 👉 Dabarki በሉ!)

Maqdala (1868)
• In 1862, Tewodros II sent a letter to Queen Victoria requesting assistance, but Captain Cameron returned without a response.
• Suspecting a plot with Egypt, Tewodros imprisoned Cameron and other Europeans.
• The British sent 32,000 troops led by Sir Robert Napier.
• Tewodros' forces, led by general Gebriye, were defeated at the Battle of Aroge on April 10, 1868.
• Tewodros committed suicide at Maqdela on April 13, 1868, to avoid capture.

👉
አፄ ቴዎድሮስ ለእንግሊዟ ንግስት ቪክቶሪያ ደብዳቤ ልከው መልስ ሳይመጣ ሲቀር ተናደው እንግሊዛውያኑን አሰሯቸው። እንግሊዝም ሮበርት ናፒየር የሚባል ጄኔራል መርታ መጣች። በአሮጌ ጦርነት (Battle of Aroge) የቴዎድሮስ ጦር ከተሸነፈ በኋላ፣ አፄ ቴዎድሮስ በእንግሊዝ እጅ ከምወድቅ ብለው ሚያዚያ 13, 1868 እራሳቸውን አጠፉ። ጀግንነት ማለት ይሄ ነው!

Gundet (1875) and Gura (1876)
• Egyptians moved to occupy Ethiopia to control the source of the Nile.
• Werner Munzinger led troops through Tajura but was killed by the Afar at Odduma.
• Emperor Yohannes IV and Ras Alula Engida mobilized 20,000 troops and severely defeated the Egyptians at Gundet on November 16, 1875.
• The Egyptians reorganized but were defeated again at Gura (March 7-9, 1876).

👉
ግብፆች አባይን ለመቆጣጠር ብለው ኢትዮጵያን መውረር ፈለጉ። አፄ ዮሐንስ 4ኛ እና ጀግናው ራስ አሉላ አባነጋ መጥተው ግብፆችን ሁለት ጊዜ አሳረሯቸው፤ መጀመሪያ ጉንደት (1875) ላይ፣ ቀጥሎ ደግሞ ጉራ (1876) ላይ።

Dogali (1887) & Metemma (1889)
• Italian forces occupied Sa'ati, Aylet, and Wia.
• Ras Alula decisively defeated the Italians at Dogali on 26 January 1887.
• Meanwhile, Mahdists opened attacks on Ethiopia.
• Emperor Yohannes IV postponed his campaign to Shewa and marched to Metemma, where he died fighting the Mahdists on March 9, 1889.

👉
ጣልያኖች ቀስ እያሉ ሰርገው ሲገቡ፣ ራስ አሉላ ዶጋሊ ላይ (1887) ልካቸውን ነገሯቸው! በሌላ በኩል ሱዳኖች (Mahdists) ወረራ ሲያደርጉ አፄ ዮሐንስ መተማ ላይ ሄደው እየተዋጉ ሞቱ። አፄ ዮሐንስ ሀገራቸውን ሲጠብቁ ህይወታቸውን የሰጡ ትልቅ ንጉስ ናቸው!

The Battle of Adwa and Its Aftermath
• The disagreement on the Wuchale Treaty led to war between Ethiopia and Italy.
• Menilek mobilized about 100,000 troops to Wara-Illu.
• At Mekelle, Italians were besieged and denied access to a water well by a stratagem developed by Empress Taytu.
• Ethiopian forces decisively defeated the Italian columns at Adwa on 1st March 1896.
• Italy was forced to recognize the independence of Ethiopia by the treaty of Addis Ababa (Oct 26, 1896).
• The victory inspired Africans; Marcus Garvey used phrases like "Ethiopia thou land of our fathers."

👉
የውጫሌ ውል ማጭበርበር የፈጠረው ታላቁ የዓድዋ ጦርነት! አፄ ምኒልክ 100,000 ጦር አዘመቱ። እቴጌ ጣይቱ ጣልያኖችን ውሃ እንዳያገኙ አድርገው በውሃ ጥም ቀጧቸው (ብልህነት!)። በመጨረሻም ማርች 1, 1896 ኢትዮጵያ አንፀባራቂ ድል ተቀዳጀች። ይሄ ድል ለመላው ጥቁር ህዝብ የነፃነት ተምሳሌት ሆኗል፤ ማርከስ ጋርቬይ (Marcus Garvey) ሳይቀር በኢትዮጵያ ስም ይዘምር ነበር።


6.5.3. The Italian Occupation (1936-41) and the Patriotic Resistance

Background & Walwal Incident
• Fascists led by Benito Mussolini came to power in 1922, determined to erase the shameful scar of Adwa.
• Mussolini searched for a pretext and found it in the Walwal Incident (December 5, 1934), caused by a lack of boundary demarcation.

👉
ሙሶሎኒ የተባለው የጣልያን መሪ የዓድዋን ሽንፈት ለመበቀል ቆርጦ ተነሳ። ሰበብ ሲፈልግ ዋልዋል (Walwal) በሚባል የድንበር አካባቢ ግጭት ተፈጠረ፤ ይሄንንም እንደ ምክንያት ተጠቅሞ ጦርነት ጀመረ።

The 1935 Invasion and its Aftermath
• Northern Front: Ethiopian counter-offensive failed due to a lack of coordination among commanders (Ras Emiru, Ras Kasa, Ras Seyoum, Ras Mulugeta).
• Major losses occurred at the first Battle in Temben, Amba-Aradom (where Ras Mulugeta died), and the Second Battle of Temben.
• The final culmination was at Maychew on March 31, 1936, where Ethiopian forces (including the Kebur Zebegna) lost to Italian ground and air bombardment.
• Southern Front: Led by Ras Desta Damtew and Dejjazmach Nesibu Zamanuel, the army was better equipped but eventually lost at Qorahe and Genale Dorya.
• Italians entered Addis Ababa on May 5, 1936.

👉
በ1935 በተደረገው ጦርነት የኢትዮጵያ የጦር አዛዦች ቅንጅት ስላነሳቸው በሰሜኑ ግንባር (ተንቤን፣ አምባ አራዶም) ተሸነፉ። ማይጨው ላይ ትልቅ ፍልሚያ ተደርጎ (March 31, 1936) ጣልያኖች በመርዝ ጋዝ እና በአውሮፕላን ስለደበደቡን ልናሸንፍ አልቻልንም። በመጨረሻም ጣልያኖች ግንቦት 5 ቀን አዲስ አበባ ገቡ።

Italian Administration (AOI)
• Italians merged Ethiopia, Italian Somaliland, and Eritrea to form Italian East Africa (Africa Orientale Italiana - AOI).
• It had six regions with top-heavy bureaucracy and corruption.
• The governors were Marshal Badoglio, Marshal Graziani, and Amadeo Umberto.
• Legacies included architecture, clean water/electricity, expansion of prostitution, road construction, and deliberately fostering ethnic/religious division.

👉
ጣልያኖች ኢትዮጵያን፣ ኤርትራን እና ሶማሊያን አንድ ላይ ጨፍልቀው AOI (Italian East Africa) ብለው ሰየሟት። ባዶሊዮ፣ ግራዚያኒ እና አሜዲዮ ኡምቤርቶ የሚባሉ አስተዳዳሪዎችን ሾሙ። በመጥፎ ጎኑ ዘረኝነትን፣ ዝሙት አዳሪነትን እና መለያየትን አመጡ። በጥሩ ጎኑ ደግሞ ህንፃዎችን፣ መንገዶችን እና የከተማ መብራትን አሰሩ (ምንም እንኳን ለራሳቸው ብለው ቢሰሩትም)።

The Patriotic Resistance Movement
• 1st Phase (Conventional): A five-pronged assault in the summer of 1936 failed.
• Abreha Deboch and Moges Asgedom hurled a bomb at Graziani on February 19, 1937.
• In retaliation, Italian Black Shirts chopped heads, burning down houses, killing about 30,000 Ethiopians in Addis Ababa and executing 297 monks at Debre Libanos.
• 2nd Phase (Guerrilla Warfare): Patriots transitioned to hit-and-run tactics. Women like Lekyelesh Beyan and Kebedech Seyoum led their own armies.
• The resistance was handicapped by collaborators called banda and a lack of a unified command structure.
• Liberation: External support came from Britain during WWII. The Gideon force (British and Ethiopian troops) helped Emperor Haile-Selassie return to Addis Ababa on May 5, 1941.

👉
አርበኞቻችን ዝም ብለው አላዩዋቸውም! በየካቲት 12 (Feb 19, 1937) አብርሃ ደቦጭ እና ሞገስ አስገዶም ግራዚያኒ ላይ ቦምብ ጣሉበት። ጣልያኖች በበቀል 30,000 ንፁሃንን ሲፈጁ፣ የደብረ ሊባኖስ መነኮሳትም አልተረፉም። ከዛ በኋላ አርበኞቹ በጫካ የደፈጣ ውጊያ (Guerrilla warfare) ጣልያንን አስለቀሷት። ሴት ጀግኖችም እንደ ለቅየለሽ በያን የራሳቸውን ጦር መርተዋል። ትልቁ ችግር የነበረው ሆዳሙ "ባንዳ" ነበር! በመጨረሻም እንግሊዝ አግዛን አፄ ኃይለሥላሴ ልክ ጣልያን በገባችበት ቀን ግንቦት 5 (May 5, 1941) በድል አድራጊነት አዲስ አበባ ገቡ!


ይሄው ጨረስን! 🎉
አሁን Chapter 6ን በኪሳችሁ ከታችኋል ማለት ነው። ለፈተና ስትገቡ እነዚህን ፖይንቶች፣ ዓመተ-ምህረቶች እና ስሞች ካስታወሳችሁ 'A+' ማምጣት የተረጋገጠ ነው! በሌላ ቻፕተር እስከምንገናኝ ድረስ ደህና ሁኑ። ቻው ጀግኖች! 💪💙
